description: This file defines the IGrainLocator interface for locating and managing grain activation addresses within an Orleans cluster.

classes.name: IGrainLocator
classes.description: Interface for locating Grain activation addresses, including registration, deregistration, lookup, cache management, and cache invalidation within an Orleans cluster.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers the provided grain address in the directory and returns the registered address.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Deregisters a grain address from the directory.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Finds the address for a specified grain id.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates the cache with placement info or activation address for a grain.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries associated with a specific grain id.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a specific grain address.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to find the grain address in the local cache without a network call.
